title: kate-ui: remember a side-by-side session
summary: session_layout_json stores paths, the active index, and whether the panes are side by side. session_layout_from_json reads that object back. The paths-only session_json stays as it is. The test goes in the existing profile tests module. This waits for PKT-0025.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

definitions.definition: fn session_layout_json(paths: &[String], active: usize, horizontal: bool) -> String

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: profile.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Add SessionLayout, session_layout_json, and session_layout_from_json. Keep the two functions pub(crate). Add #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))] on each function. The JSON keys are paths, active, and horizontal. session_layout_from_json uses let Ok(parsed) = serde_json::from_str(text) else { return None }. Do not match Ok and Err by hand. Do not nest an if inside an if.  Do not write two if arms that return the same value. Combine them with ||. That is clippy::if_same_then_else. Do not change SessionPaths, session_json, or session_from_json. The existing test session_json_round_trips_paths stays green. Do not rewrite its assertions. The test session_layout_round_trips_a_horizontal_split writes a.rs and b.rs, active 0, and horizontal true. session_layout_from_json returns those paths, active 0, and true. session_layout_from_json of {} is None. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines. Stay inside this one behavior. Run the full test module named in the commands, not only the new test.

regression_tests.name: profile::tests::session_layout_round_trips_a_horizontal_split
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because session_layout_json does not exist. After the change two paths, active 0, and horizontal true round-trip. An empty object returns None.
